model_annotation: The diagram presents three donut charts comparing enterprises, employment, and net turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021. There are three charts, each divided into four sectors: industry, construction, trade, and other services. The first chart, labeled "Number of Enterprises," has four sectors, with "other services" being the largest at 61% or 19.6 million, followed by "trade" at 19% or 5.9 million, "construction" at 13% or 3.7 million, and "industry" being the smallest at 8% or 2.4 million. The second chart, labeled "Number of Persons Employed," is also divided into four sectors, with "other services" accounting for 51% or 60.2 million, "trade" at 19% or 29.3 million, "industry" at 21% or 33.0 million, and "construction" at 9% or 13.4 million. The third chart, labeled "Turnover," has four sectors, with "industry" representing 33% or 10.6 trillion, "other services" at 31% or 9.8 trillion, "trade" at 31% or 9.5 trillion, and "construction" at 6% or 1.9 trillion. A legend is provided on the left side of the diagram, and each sector is color-coded, with the percentages and values displayed within the respective sectors.
